def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
def save(p,v):
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
def rel(p):return str(p.relative_to(ROOT))
def fp(p):
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        return dict(path=rel(p),sha256=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest(),size=p.stat().st_size)
def check(f):
    p=ROOT/f['path'];assert fp(p)==f,p;return p
def grade(y):
    y=y.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
    g=y.groupby(level='datetime');r=g.rank(method='average').to_numpy()*2;n=g.transform('size').to_numpy()
    return pd.Series(((10*r.astype('int64')-1)//(2*n)).astype(np.int8),index=y.index)

from common import *

def decisions(p, cadence):
    if cadence=='daily':
        return p.copy()
    pieces=[]
    for _,g in p.groupby(p.index.to_period('M')):
        vals=np.full(len(g),g.iloc[0],dtype=float)
        if cadence=='fifth' and len(g)>=5:
            vals[4:]=g.iloc[:5].mean()
        pieces.append(pd.Series(vals,index=g.index))
    return pd.concat(pieces)

def performance(r):
    r=np.asarray(r,dtype=float)
    logtotal=np.log1p(r).sum()
    nav=np.exp(np.cumsum(np.log1p(r)))
    peak=np.maximum.accumulate(np.r_[1.,nav])[1:]
    a=float(r.mean()*238);vol=float(r.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(238))
    return dict(n=len(r),cagr=float(np.expm1(logtotal*238/len(r))),net_ann=a,net_sharpe=float(a/vol),ann_vol=vol,max_drawdown=float((nav/peak-1).min()),cum_net=float(np.expm1(logtotal)))

class Portfolios:
    def __init__(self,baskets):
        px=pd.read_parquet(TMP/'close.parquet')
        volume=pd.read_parquet(TMP/'volume.parquet').reindex_like(px)
        self.calendar=px.index
        self.columns=px.columns
        self.valid=px.notna().values & volume.gt(0).values
        marks=px.ffill().values
        self.growth=np.ones_like(marks)
        np.divide(marks[1:],marks[:-1],out=self.growth[1:],where=(marks[:-1]>0)&(marks[1:]>0))
        from qlib.backtest.cn_limit import limit_cap_array
        self.cap_pre=limit_cap_array(px.columns,[pd.Timestamp('2020-08-03')]*len(px.columns))
        self.cap_post=limit_cap_array(px.columns,[pd.Timestamp('2020-08-24')]*len(px.columns))
        self.n=len(px.columns)
        self.entry=px.index.get_indexer(baskets.index)+1
        self.weights={}
        for k,h in [('V',5),('V',7),('V',20),('O',5),('O',7),('O',20),('T',20),('N',7)]:
            cols=baskets[[k+str(j) for j in range(3)]]
            ids=px.columns.get_indexer(cols.to_numpy().ravel()).reshape(-1,3)
            assert (ids>=0).all()
            by_day={}
            for i,e in enumerate(self.entry):
                idx=ids[i]
                path=marks[e:e+h,idx]/marks[e,idx]
                assert path.shape==(h,3) and np.isfinite(path).all() and (path>0).all()
                by_day[e]=(idx,path/path.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True))
            self.weights[(k,h)]=by_day

    def run(self,cal,route,nonT,control=None,constrained=False):
        first=self.calendar.get_loc(cal[0]);last=self.calendar.get_loc(cal[-1])
        starts=self.calendar.get_indexer(route.index)+1
        if control:
            choices=[control]*len(route)
        else:
            choices=[('T',20) if v else (nonT,7) for v in route]
        choice=dict(zip(starts,choices))
        assert all(e+h<=last for e,(_,h) in choice.items())
        before=np.zeros(self.n)
        cohort=[]; records=[]
        for d in range(first,last+1):
            valued=before*self.growth[d]
            gross=1.+float((valued-before).sum())
            assert gross>0
            drift=valued/gross
            cohort=[v for v in cohort if d-v[0]<v[1]]
            if d in choice:
                k,h=choice[d];idx,path=self.weights[(k,h)][d]
                cohort.append((d,h,idx,path))
            weights=np.zeros(self.n)
            if cohort:
                norm=sum(1/h for _,h,_,_ in cohort)
                for e,h,idx,path in cohort:
                    weights[idx]+=path[d-e]/(h*norm)
                assert np.isclose(weights.sum(),1,atol=1e-12)
            # Budget is post-fee NAV. Solve the self-financing trade exactly to tolerance.
            cost=0.
            for _ in range(5):
                delta=weights*(1-cost)-drift
                buy=delta.clip(min=0).sum();sell=-delta.clip(max=0).sum()
                cost=ev.COST_ONE_WAY_BUY*buy+ev.COST_ONE_WAY_SELL*sell
            assert abs((weights*(1-cost)).sum()-(drift.sum()+buy-sell))<1e-11
            if constrained:
                # Stale/limit-lock holdings remain in the book; available cash funds allowed buys.
                from qlib.backtest.cn_limit import CHINEXT_WIDE_FROM
                caps=self.cap_post if self.calendar[d]>=CHINEXT_WIDE_FROM else self.cap_pre
                ret=self.growth[d]-1.
                allowed_sell=self.valid[d] & (ret>-caps)
                allowed_buy=self.valid[d] & (ret<caps)
                sells=np.where(allowed_sell,(-delta).clip(min=0),0.)
                buys=np.where(allowed_buy,delta.clip(min=0),0.)
                sell=sells.sum()
                cash=max(0.,1.-drift.sum())+sell*(1.-ev.COST_ONE_WAY_SELL)
                if buys.sum()>0:
                    buys*=min(1.,cash/((1.+ev.COST_ONE_WAY_BUY)*buys.sum()))
                buy=buys.sum()
                cost=buy*ev.COST_ONE_WAY_BUY+sell*ev.COST_ONE_WAY_SELL
                delta=buys-sells
                weights=(drift+delta)/(1.-cost)
                assert weights.min()>-1e-10 and weights.sum()<=1.+1e-10
            unresolved=float(np.abs(delta[~self.valid[d]]).sum())
            records.append([gross*(1-cost)-1,float(cost),float((buy+sell)/2),float(weights.sum()),unresolved])
            before=weights
        frame=pd.DataFrame(records,columns=['net','cost','turnover','exposure','unquoted_trade_fraction'],index=cal)
        assert constrained or frame.exposure.iloc[-1]==0
        perf=performance(frame.net)
        perf.update(cost_annual=float(238*frame.cost.mean()),turnover_daily=float(frame.turnover.mean()),exposure=float(frame.exposure.mean()),unquoted_trade_days=int(frame.unquoted_trade_fraction.gt(1e-10).sum()),unquoted_trade_fraction_sum=float(frame.unquoted_trade_fraction.sum()))
        return perf,frame

from common import *
import qlib,gc
from qlib.data import D
from engine import Portfolios
def main():
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROV),region='cn',kernels=1)
    cal=pd.DatetimeIndex(D.calendar(start_time=START,end_time=END))
    mapping=pd.read_parquet(BASE/'data/h20month-dates.parquet')
    days=mapping.loc[START:END].index[mapping.loc[START:END].ready.le(END)]
    assert len(days)==1431 and str(days[-1].date())=='2026-06-30'
    pick=mapping.loc[days,'style'].eq('T');assert pick.sum()==408
    labels=ev.prepare_pool_labels('all',START,END,[5,7,20],{h:ev.label_window_cutoff(cal,h) for h in [5,7,20]},min_listing_days=60,st_daily=PROV.parent/'st_daily.csv',min_amount=1e7)
    tradable=ev.entry_tradable_mask('all',START,END)
    manifests=read(BASE/'configs/models.json');rankics={};baskets=[]
    for key,manifest in manifests.items():
        s=pd.read_pickle(check(manifest['ensemble'])).squeeze()
        assert np.isfinite(s).all() and s.index.is_unique and s.index.is_monotonic_increasing
        rows={}
        for h in (5,7,20):
            y=labels[h]
            calc=ev.daily_ic(s,y,min_count=20).loc[days]
            rows['raw_h'+str(h)]=calc['rank_ic']
            if h in (7,20):
                measured=ev.daily_ic(s,grade(y),min_count=20).loc[days]['rank_ic']
                frozen=pd.read_csv(BASE/'data'/f'{key}-h{h}-daily-rankic.csv',index_col='datetime',parse_dates=True).loc[days,'ensemble']
                assert np.allclose(measured,frozen,rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
                rows['grade_h'+str(h)]=measured
        r=pd.DataFrame(rows);rankics[key]=r
        r.to_csv(BASE/'data'/f'{key}-daily-rankic.csv',index_label='date')
        p=s.reindex(labels[20].index).dropna()
        p=p[tradable.reindex(p.index).fillna(False)]
        p=p[p.index.get_level_values('datetime').isin(days)]
        pos=p.groupby(level='datetime').rank(ascending=False,method='first')
        top=p[pos.le(3)].rename('score').reset_index().groupby('datetime').instrument.agg(list).loc[days]
        assert top.map(len).eq(3).all()
        baskets.append(pd.DataFrame(top.tolist(),index=days,columns=[key+str(j) for j in range(3)]))
        del s,p;gc.collect();print('rankic verified',key,flush=True)
    baskets=pd.concat(baskets,axis=1);baskets.to_csv(BASE/'data/top3-baskets.csv',index_label='signal')
    oldb=pd.read_csv(ROUTE/'data/top3-baskets.csv',index_col='signal',parse_dates=True)
    assert baskets[oldb.columns].equals(oldb)
    inst=sorted(set(baskets.to_numpy().ravel()))
    quotes=D.features(inst,['$close','$volume'],start_time=START,end_time=END)
    close=quotes['$close'].unstack(level='instrument').reindex(index=cal,columns=inst).astype('float64')
    volume=quotes['$volume'].unstack(level='instrument').reindex_like(close)
    close.to_parquet(TMP/'close.parquet');volume.to_parquet(TMP/'volume.parquet')
    # Retain only the selected-stock market data needed to reproduce the full-window comparison.
    close.to_parquet(BASE/'data/selected-stock-close.parquet')
    volume.to_parquet(BASE/'data/selected-stock-volume.parquet')
    engine=Portfolios(baskets);results=[];pnl={};recipes={}
    def run(key,title,model,h=None):
        control=(model,h) if h else None
        result,frame=engine.run(cal,pick,model,control=control)
        pnl[key]=frame
        results.append(dict(id=key,name=title,metrics=result))
        recipes[key]=dict(model=model,horizon=h)
    run('oracle','事后自然月专家 · T H20／非 T H7','N')
    run('new-v5-h5','新 v5 · 固定 H5','V',5)
    run('new-v5-h7','新 v5 · 固定 H7','V',7)
    run('new-v5-h20','新 v5 · 固定 H20','V',20)
    run('v5-h5','v5 Benchmark · 固定 H5','O',5)
    original=engine.weights['T',20]
    engine.weights['T',20]=engine.weights['V',20]
    run('new-v5-matched','新 v5 · 按真实风格 H20／H7','V')
    engine.weights['T',20]=engine.weights['O',20]
    run('v5-matched','v5 Benchmark · 按真实风格 H20／H7','O')
    engine.weights['T',20]=original
    oldp=pd.read_parquet(ROUTE/'data/net-daily-full.parquet')
    for key,oldkey in [('oracle','oracle-N'),('new-v5-h7','always-V7'),('new-v5-h20','always-V20')]:
        assert np.allclose(pnl[key].net,oldp[oldkey],rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
    h5=read(ROUTE/'metrics/new-v5-fixed-holding.json')['results']['full']['5']
    assert abs(pnl['new-v5-h5'].net.mean()*238-h5['net_ann'])<1e-12
    own=rankics['T'].where(pick,rankics['N'],axis=0)
    grade_own=own.grade_h20.where(pick,own.grade_h7)
    grade_out=pd.DataFrame({'style':pick.map({True:'T',False:'N'})},index=days)
    for row in results:
        k=row['id'];frame=pnl[k];m=row['metrics'];source=own if k=='oracle' else rankics[recipes[k]['model']]
        g=source.grade_h20.where(pick,source.grade_h7)
        v=dict(net_ann=m['net_ann'],net_ann_vol=m['ann_vol'],net_sharpe=m['net_sharpe'],ann=float(((1+frame.net)/(1-frame.cost)-1).mean()*238),turnover=m['turnover_daily'],rank_ic_mean=float(source.raw_h5.mean()),rank_ic_grade=float(g.mean()),cagr=m['cagr'],max_drawdown=m['max_drawdown'],ann_cost=m['cost_annual'])
        row['metrics']=v
        row.update(n_days=len(cal),signal_days=len(days),years={str(yr):float(ev.TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR*group.net.mean()) for yr,group in frame.groupby(frame.index.year)})
        grade_out[k]=g
        assert np.isclose(m['net_sharpe'],np.sqrt(238)*frame.net.mean()/frame.net.std())
        assert np.isclose(m['cagr'],(1+frame.net).prod()**(238/len(frame))-1)
    grade_out.to_csv(BASE/'data/comparison-grade-rankic.csv',index_label='date')
    pd.concat(pnl,names=['variant','date']).to_parquet(BASE/'data/portfolio-daily.parquet')
    conditional={}
    for style in ['T','N']:
        at=pick.eq(style=='T')
        conditional[style]={key:float(grade_out.loc[at,key].mean()) for key in ['oracle','new-v5-matched','v5-matched']}
    save(BASE/'metrics/comparison.json',dict(style_expert_protocol='natural-month-h20-oracle-v1',seeds=SEEDS,window=[START,END],n_days=len(cal),signal_days=len(days),last_signal=str(days[-1].date()),style_days={'T':int(pick.sum()),'N':int((~pick).sum())},selected='oracle',rows=results,conditional_rankic=conditional,rankic_definition='Each day Spearman(score,H20-decile) on true T days, else Spearman(score,H7-decile); equal-weight mean over all common signals. Global h5 RankIC uses ungraded H5 returns on the same dates.',portfolio_definition='Daily self-financing normalized 1/H allocation among active Top3 cohorts. Fractional shares, net-stock fees, historical entry filter; marked exits, no minimum ticket or slippage.',new_fits=0))
    print([(r['id'],r['metrics']) for r in results],flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()

from common import *

def decisions(p, cadence):
    if cadence=='daily':
        return p.copy()
    pieces=[]
    for _,g in p.groupby(p.index.to_period('M')):
        vals=np.full(len(g),g.iloc[0],dtype=float)
        if cadence=='fifth' and len(g)>=5:
            vals[4:]=g.iloc[:5].mean()
        pieces.append(pd.Series(vals,index=g.index))
    return pd.concat(pieces)

def performance(r):
    r=np.asarray(r,dtype=float)
    logtotal=np.log1p(r).sum()
    nav=np.exp(np.cumsum(np.log1p(r)))
    peak=np.maximum.accumulate(np.r_[1.,nav])[1:]
    a=float(r.mean()*238);vol=float(r.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(238))
    return dict(n=len(r),cagr=float(np.expm1(logtotal*238/len(r))),net_ann=a,net_sharpe=float(a/vol),ann_vol=vol,max_drawdown=float((nav/peak-1).min()),cum_net=float(np.expm1(logtotal)))

class Portfolios:
    def __init__(self,baskets):
        px=pd.read_parquet(BASE/'data/selected-stock-close.parquet')
        volume=pd.read_parquet(BASE/'data/selected-stock-volume.parquet').reindex_like(px)
        self.calendar=px.index
        self.columns=px.columns
        self.valid=px.notna().values & volume.gt(0).values
        marks=px.ffill().values
        self.growth=np.ones_like(marks)
        np.divide(marks[1:],marks[:-1],out=self.growth[1:],where=(marks[:-1]>0)&(marks[1:]>0))
        from qlib.backtest.cn_limit import limit_cap_array
        self.cap_pre=limit_cap_array(px.columns,[pd.Timestamp('2020-08-03')]*len(px.columns))
        self.cap_post=limit_cap_array(px.columns,[pd.Timestamp('2020-08-24')]*len(px.columns))
        self.n=len(px.columns)
        self.entry=px.index.get_indexer(baskets.index)+1
        self.weights={}
        for k,h in [('V',5),('V',7),('V',20),('O',5),('O',7),('O',20),('T',20),('N',7)]:
            cols=baskets[[k+str(j) for j in range(3)]]
            ids=px.columns.get_indexer(cols.to_numpy().ravel()).reshape(-1,3)
            assert (ids>=0).all()
            by_day={}
            for i,e in enumerate(self.entry):
                idx=ids[i]
                path=marks[e:e+h,idx]/marks[e,idx]
                assert path.shape==(h,3) and np.isfinite(path).all() and (path>0).all()
                by_day[e]=(idx,path/path.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True))
            self.weights[(k,h)]=by_day

    def run(self,cal,route,nonT,control=None,constrained=False):
        first=self.calendar.get_loc(cal[0]);last=self.calendar.get_loc(cal[-1])
        starts=self.calendar.get_indexer(route.index)+1
        if control:
            choices=[control]*len(route)
        else:
            choices=[('T',20) if v else (nonT,7) for v in route]
        choice=dict(zip(starts,choices))
        assert all(e+h<=last for e,(_,h) in choice.items())
        before=np.zeros(self.n)
        cohort=[]; records=[]
        for d in range(first,last+1):
            valued=before*self.growth[d]
            gross=1.+float((valued-before).sum())
            assert gross>0
            drift=valued/gross
            cohort=[v for v in cohort if d-v[0]<v[1]]
            if d in choice:
                k,h=choice[d];idx,path=self.weights[(k,h)][d]
                cohort.append((d,h,idx,path))
            weights=np.zeros(self.n)
            if cohort:
                norm=sum(1/h for _,h,_,_ in cohort)
                for e,h,idx,path in cohort:
                    weights[idx]+=path[d-e]/(h*norm)
                assert np.isclose(weights.sum(),1,atol=1e-12)
            # Budget is post-fee NAV. Solve the self-financing trade exactly to tolerance.
            cost=0.
            for _ in range(5):
                delta=weights*(1-cost)-drift
                buy=delta.clip(min=0).sum();sell=-delta.clip(max=0).sum()
                cost=ev.COST_ONE_WAY_BUY*buy+ev.COST_ONE_WAY_SELL*sell
            assert abs((weights*(1-cost)).sum()-(drift.sum()+buy-sell))<1e-11
            if constrained:
                # Stale/limit-lock holdings remain in the book; available cash funds allowed buys.
                from qlib.backtest.cn_limit import CHINEXT_WIDE_FROM
                caps=self.cap_post if self.calendar[d]>=CHINEXT_WIDE_FROM else self.cap_pre
                ret=self.growth[d]-1.
                allowed_sell=self.valid[d] & (ret>-caps)
                allowed_buy=self.valid[d] & (ret<caps)
                sells=np.where(allowed_sell,(-delta).clip(min=0),0.)
                buys=np.where(allowed_buy,delta.clip(min=0),0.)
                sell=sells.sum()
                cash=max(0.,1.-drift.sum())+sell*(1.-ev.COST_ONE_WAY_SELL)
                if buys.sum()>0:
                    buys*=min(1.,cash/((1.+ev.COST_ONE_WAY_BUY)*buys.sum()))
                buy=buys.sum()
                cost=buy*ev.COST_ONE_WAY_BUY+sell*ev.COST_ONE_WAY_SELL
                delta=buys-sells
                weights=(drift+delta)/(1.-cost)
                assert weights.min()>-1e-10 and weights.sum()<=1.+1e-10
            unresolved=float(np.abs(delta[~self.valid[d]]).sum())
            records.append([gross*(1-cost)-1,float(cost),float((buy+sell)/2),float(weights.sum()),unresolved])
            before=weights
        frame=pd.DataFrame(records,columns=['net','cost','turnover','exposure','unquoted_trade_fraction'],index=cal)
        assert constrained or frame.exposure.iloc[-1]==0
        perf=performance(frame.net)
        perf.update(cost_annual=float(238*frame.cost.mean()),turnover_daily=float(frame.turnover.mean()),exposure=float(frame.exposure.mean()),unquoted_trade_days=int(frame.unquoted_trade_fraction.gt(1e-10).sum()),unquoted_trade_fraction_sum=float(frame.unquoted_trade_fraction.sum()))
        return perf,frame
